title: Aster
description: A calendar for people who schedule other people. I designed and built the week view, the conflict resolver, and the keyboard layer.

title: Halyard
description: A 140-component design system for a payments company, and the documentation site that made anyone actually use it.

title: Field Notes
description: A Figma plugin that pulls real production copy into designs, so nobody ships a screen full of placeholder text again.

title: Northbound
description: Identity and site for a small expedition outfit in Tromsø. Six pages, one typeface, no stock photography.

title: Tessera
description: A headless data table for React that handles a hundred thousand rows without a virtual scroller. Around 4k stars, and still my most-used thing.

title: Passage
description: A reading app built around one idea: never show a list of things you have not read yet.
